thread:
erin: Opened PR #4823 to provision a new GPU pool for inference-batch. Proposal: A10G x8 per node, reserved capacity toggle for Dedicated customers + spot fallback for burst. Can someone scan the TF + k8s snippets? Also need guidance on secrets wiring for cloud creds/KMS.
jason: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4823 :eyes: grabbing a quick pass now.
maya: Quick q — how are we planning to handle spot/preemptible eviction? node-termination-handler + draining, or rely on CA + PDBs?
kevin: node-termination-handler + graceful cordon/drain is required. For long-running jobs we should set PodDisruptionBudget to avoid data loss. Also plan for fallback to on-demand pool when reserved capacity is insufficient.
sasha: Pushed a short TF snippet in the PR to show the pool config (trimmed):
```hcl
resource "google_container_node_pool" "inference_batch" {
  name = "inference-batch"
  node_config {
    machine_type = "n1-standard-16"
    accelerators { type = "nvidia-a10" count = 1 }
    preemptible = var.use_spot
    metadata = { startup-script = file("scripts/gpu-setup.sh") }
  }
  autoscaling { min_node_count = 0 max_node_count = 30 }
}
```
erin: For Dedicated customers we enable `reserved = true` which will create a capacity reservation resource in cloud. The var is `var.pool_reservation.type = "zonal" | "none"` and we gate preemptible only when reservation == "none".
jason: Secret wiring idea: store the SA key in KMS-encrypted Secret Manager / Parameter Store and expose to cluster via CSI Secrets Store. Example (local dev): `kubectl create secret generic gcp-creds --from-file=key.json=./key.json` but production should use CSI + workload identity.
maya: Also add node taint so only inference workloads land here: `kubectl taint nodes <name> gpu=true:NoSchedule` and add toleration to inference DaemonSet/Deployment. Small toleration example in pod spec below.
```yaml
tolerations:
- key: "gpu"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "true"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
```
devops-bot: CI: terraform fmt/validate OK, plan successful but k8s manifests lint failed (pod-security cfg), see pipeline #4823.
kevin: Also ensure nodes get label `node.k8s.redwood/gpu-pool=inference-batch` so runtime routing/batching can pick them (we use that label in smart routing).
sasha: LGTM after we wire KMS secret path into the TF module and change the taint key to `redwood.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule`. I'll add the GPU driver startup-script PR comment.
erin: Thanks — I'll update the PR with KMS secret path + add a short doc block on eviction handling and fallback strategy. Plan: merge after CI green and a brief runbook entry for on-call (eviction timeline, rollback steps).
jason: One more: add `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict: "false"` annotation on latency-sensitive pods we don't want to evict during scale-down.
kevin: Right, and for batch inference workers we keep `safe-to-evict: true` so CA can scale them down when spot is reclaimed.
sasha: I'll volunteer to write the runbook section and the startup script tweak.
erin: Perfect. Thx all — tagging @channel in the PR for visibility. :thumbsup:
